maison.label: The Maison
maison.title: A personal language of couture.
maison.intro: Every gown begins with a conversation. A feeling, a gesture, a moment you want to hold.
maison.body: At Shado Badr, bridal and evening pieces are made to measure in Cairo. Silhouette, cloth and detail come together around the woman who will wear them.
maison.closing: Nothing is chosen without you. Nothing is made without care.
maison.caption: 01 / THE HAND OF THE MAISON

collection.label: The Collection
collection.title: Studies in silhouette.
collection.note: Four first expressions of the maison. Each a beginning, never a limit.
collection.hint: Scroll the collection or use the arrow keys
collection.craftNote: A closer look at the construction and finishing. Detailed photography and craftsmanship notes will be added with each gown.

bridal.label: Bridal
bridal.title: A quiet kind of extraordinary.
bridal.body: Light on the skin. Considered in every fold. A bridal gown shaped around your own sense of occasion.

evening.label: Evening
evening.title: Presence, without a word.
evening.body: Sculptural lines, warm colour and the movement of cloth. Evening pieces made for the way you want to feel.

journey.label: The Journey
journey.title: From a thought to a gown.
journey.note: A considered process, with you at its heart.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We listen to your occasion, your ideas and the way you want to feel.

steps.title: Design & sketch
steps.body: A silhouette takes shape through a personal exchange.

steps.title: Fabric selection
steps.body: Weight, texture and movement guide the choice of cloth.

steps.title: Pattern & toile
steps.body: The first form is built, studied and refined.

steps.title: Fittings
steps.body: Proportion and fit are adjusted on you, with care.

steps.title: Finishing
steps.body: The final details are placed and finished by hand.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Your gown, ready for its moment.

craft.label: Savoir-faire
craft.title: The beauty is in the attention.
craft.hint: Select a study to look closer.

items.title: The fold
items.body: Drape is studied in movement, letting the cloth find its line.

items.title: The stitch
items.body: Quiet construction gives a silhouette its confidence.

items.title: The embellishment
items.body: Detail is considered as part of the whole, never an afterthought.

items.q: Are all gowns made to measure?
items.a: Yes. Bridal and evening gowns are created around each client, beginning with a private consultation.

items.q: When should I get in touch?
items.a: As early as you can. The atelier will discuss your event date and confirm a realistic making schedule before you commit.
Please do. Images, a fabric, or simply a feeling can begin our conversation.
Fittings are arranged by appointment in Cairo. The atelier will share the exact location with your confirmation.

visit.title: We look forward to meeting you.
visit.body: Cairo, Egypt. Private visits and fittings by confirmed appointment.
visit.hours: Opening hours · to be confirmed by the founder
